definition.name: artifact
definition.description: Save, update or list your artifacts: lasting outputs (reports, takeoffs, estimates, pages, apps) kept as versioned files in your workspace, which the user keeps and later turns refer to by name. save: name, type and either content (written to artifacts/<name>) or from_path (a file you wrote). update: name or id, then the new full content, a different from_path, or neither to record your own edit of the file. list: what you made, with each file's path and whether it changed. Read an artifact with read_file. The artifacts skill says when to save one.

name.description: save: a stable name, unique for this agent (e.g. "clash-report.md"). update: the artifact to change (or use id)

id.description: update: the artifact's id, instead of its name

type.description: save: MIME type ("text/markdown", "text/csv", "text/html", "application/json") or a domain type ("aec/takeoff"); a real MIME type lets the Artifacts panel render it. list: only artifacts of this type

content.description: save/update: the complete text to write and track. Leave it out when you use from_path

from_path.description: save/update: instead of content, a workspace file to track (not copied). Content wins if both are given

description.description: save/update: one line on what this artifact is, for the user's list

tags.description: save/update: labels. list: only artifacts carrying any of these

note.description: save/update: why this version exists, shown in the version history

expected_version.description: update: only update if this is still the current version number; otherwise the call fails

this_session_only.description: list: only artifacts first created in this conversation
